reconfigure.title: Reconfigure cooker connection
reconfigure.description: Enter the cooker IP address. Leave Token blank to keep its current value. The device identity is verified before saving.

error.cannot_detect_model: Failed to detect the cooker model automatically
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device
error.cannot_verify_identity: The cooker did not return an identity that can be verified. The connection settings were not changed.

abort.wrong_device: The address points to a different cooker. The connection settings were not changed.

state.quick_preheat: Gradually raising the temperature to soften the rice.
state.water_absorption: Raising the temperature while the grains absorb water.
state.boiling: Heating to a boil so the rice cooks evenly.
state.gelatinization: Using high-temperature steam to gelatinize the grains.
state.simmering: Maintaining an even temperature to finish gelatinizing the rice.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile data which describes the temperature curve.

start_recipe.name: Start a recipe
start_recipe.description: Start a bundled CMC301 or normal3 recipe with parameters. Scheduled completion is supported only on CMC301.

no_loaded_device.message: No Xiaomi cooker is loaded. Check the integration connection.

multiple_devices.message: More than one cooker matches. Select a specific device.

device_not_found.message: The selected device was not found.

device_not_loaded.message: The selected device has no loaded cooker entry.

invalid_parameters.message: Invalid cooking parameters. Check the selected recipe and its supported options.

unsupported_option.message: The selected recipe does not support this option.

clear_schedule.message: Clear scheduled completion before saving a panel recipe.

unsupported_recipe.message: This cooker does not support the selected recipe.

whole_minutes.message: Enter a whole number of minutes.

invalid_taste.message: Select a supported taste: soft, medium or hard.

invalid_duration_option.message: Select one of the available cooking durations.

invalid_recipe.message: The recipe format or checksum is invalid. Use a trusted recipe template.

invalid_keep_warm.message: Automatic keep-warm must be on or off.

keep_warm_unsupported.message: This recipe does not support changing automatic keep-warm.

taste_unsupported.message: Only fine rice supports taste adjustment.

invalid_finish_in.message: Scheduled completion must be 0–1439 minutes; 0 starts immediately.

schedule_unsupported.message: This recipe or cooker does not support this scheduling option.

untrusted_recipe.message: CMC301 accepts only bundled recipes with supported parameter changes.

duration_out_of_range.message: Cooking duration must be between {minimum} and {maximum} minutes.

finish_too_soon.message: Scheduled completion must exceed {minimum} minutes, or be 0 for immediate cooking.

remote_denied.message: The cooker does not currently allow remote cooking.

cooker_busy.message: The cooker must be idle and free of faults before starting.

start_unconfirmed.message: The start result is uncertain. Check the cooker before retrying.

write_unconfirmed.message: The cooker did not confirm the setting change. Refresh its state before retrying.

command_failed.message: The cooker command failed or its result is uncertain. Check the device before retrying.
